title: `setTVLLimits` incorrectly assigns `_newMaxTotalDeposits` to `maxPerDeposit` instead of `maxTotalDeposits`.
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, Because the cap raiser cannot update `maxTotalDeposits` and will wrongly update `maxPerDeposit` with `_newMaxTotalDeposits`.  **Likelihood:** Medium, Because it will happened every time cap raiser want to update TVL limits.  ## Description  Current implementation of `setTVLLimits` is incorrectly assigns `_newMaxTotalDeposits` to `maxPerDeposit` instead of `maxTotalDeposits`.  ```solidity     function setTVLLimits(uint256 _newMaxPerDeposit, uint256 _newMaxTotalDeposits) external onlyCapRaiser() {         require(_newMaxPerDeposit<=_newMaxTotalDeposits, "newMaxPe
